scope: TRAIN frozen-operand equation diagnostic, not Native parity or new model/task evidence
component_repeat_trigger: pooled physical step16 drift of HOLD <= 0.5 * R2_OFFSET drift and R2_OFFSET drift > 0; then hold-offset and hold-scale on the same snapshots only

candidate_rule.first_candidate: R2_ZERO_INCLUSIVE (existing explicit contract; never OFFSET metadata branch)
candidate_rule.tie_rule: retain legacy if difference <= 1e-6 relative; no tie-based promotion
candidate_rule.rationale: Exploratory practical quality allowances fixed before measurement, not theorem or population guarantees
candidate_rule.second_candidate: At most one separate TRAIN-only fixed grid or minimal metadata revision after cause analysis; freeze contract before any candidate measurement. Do not recycle rejected R4 RNE as a new success.

aggregation: sum SSE within documents/layers; six original TRAIN documents in three shared generator families, no independent-head population CI
output_cross: snapshot: 2 inner product of next32 responses of the preexisting accumulated error and new injection, excluding future writes; not decomposition of end-to-end KL
lag_definition: uncentered same-physical-entry injection dot and energies at lag1/8; scored current token>=16 may pair to a warmup token; 240 pairs/case for each lag; zero denominator null; not centered Pearson or independence evidence
failures: Retain partial per-arm observations and exact failure context; never fill missing tokens with zeros
reference: FP32 zero-start equation from already normalized/scaled captured q/k/v/decay/beta; output before quantized storage
fidelity: Reuse original 7/18 failed 1e-4 checks; investigate source separately; do not widen or relabel as Native parity
